meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按「搜索 → 时间线 → 取详情」三步查询 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库:先给出过往会话记录的索引(含 ID、时间、标题),只对你选中的条目再拉取完整详情。
howto.when: 当你问的是过往会话而不是当前对话时触发,比如「这个我们以前解决过吗?」「上次是怎么做 X 的?」「上周发生了什么?」。

say.text: 我们以前修过这个 bug 吗?
say.note: 会检索过往会话的记录

say.text: 上次 X 是怎么实现的?
say.note: 返回相关条目标题和时间线

say.text: 搜一下 authentication 相关的记录
say.note: 返回带 ID 的结果索引表

howto.what_en: After install, Claude searches claude-mem's cross-session memory database in three steps (search, timeline, fetch): it returns past work records from earlier sessions, then fetches full details only for the IDs you pick.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions rather than the current chat, e.g. "did we already fix this?", "how did we solve X last time?", or "what happened last week?".

say_en.text: Did we already fix this bug?
How did we implement X last time?

say_en.note: Returns an index table with IDs
